rows.summary: Between 2015 and 2025 Item 6 was restructured from a 10% gross-billings royalty plus 5% support and 10% special-services administrative fees into a 4% collected-revenue contract-services royalty, a new 10% sales royalty on franchise/upgrade/transfer and financing receipts, a currently-required advertising contribution with a $450 minimum, a $20,000 renewal fee, and many newly itemized technology, audit, interim-management, and miscellaneous fees.
